t: An eight-core RISC-V mini-ITX motherboard for builders and software porters.
steps: Buy the Titan from ARACE, the official worldwide seller. Coverage in 2026 listed it at 329 US dollars.
Buy DDR4 memory, an NVMe SSD, an ATX power supply, and a mini-ITX case.
Add an AMD Radeon graphics card for a screen, or plan to run it headless.
Download an Ubuntu, Debian, or Fedora image for the Titan from the Milk-V docs.
Write the image to a USB stick and boot from it.
Install Linux to the NVMe drive.
Compile a small C program to check your toolchain.
